meta.disclosure: No fold is independent. F1 and F2 were used for feature discovery (P1.1), candidate screening (P1.3), policy selection (P1.4) and the P1.4.1 investigation; F3 was used for P1.3 and P1.4 confirmation and in P1.4.1, so this is its fourth use. The queue design itself was proposed after seeing P1.4.1 results on F1-F3. Models are the P1.4 fold models (E4 trained on steps <= T-100); floor and escalation thresholds come from the calibration window (T-99..T). The locked test (651-743) is not read. PaySim has no settlement timing, so the cost of a review delay cannot be measured: a fraud reviewed 20 hours late counts as detected here.
